svg.title: Wearclair biomarker data flow
svg.desc: Numbered flow of biomarker samples from a wearable or simulator through authenticated ingestion, TimescaleDB, relational batch tracking, Inngest worker steps, derived insight storage, and mobile refetch.
svg.text: One sync, from raw signal to user insight
The write path is replay-safe. Each background stage is isolated as a named Inngest step.
transient failures resume at the failed boundary
raw-window lineage connects derived rows to source data by value
